Mandinkakaŋ Leetaroo 3 

[Document 1: Page 1] 

Imaam Raatib Al-haaji Karaŋ Laŋ Baro be kontonna, Pakaawu Salikeñe aniŋ Al-haaji Sankuŋ 

Baro Bemme, aniŋ Arafaŋ Al-haaji Baro, aniŋ alikaaloo  Ahmadu Raaman, aniŋ Arafaŋ Bunjaa 

Siisee wo le ko i baa sindi la baadiŋ musilimoolu la ko siyaaree miŋ i dalta a kela saŋo-saŋ,  i naata 

i baa ke la tubaabu karoo muwaa de marsi til taŋ. I be a kela wo le la. I be a sindi la alfaa baa ma:

● Al-haaji Soloo Baroo, Sinkeer 

● Almaami Baa Jaane Daraame

[Document 2: Page 1] 

Bismi l-Lāhi al-Raḥmāni al-Raḥīmi 

Ṣalla l-Lāhu ta ͑ālā ͑alā Sayyidina Muḥammadin, khayrul anīm. 

Ammā ba ͑ad, fa hādhihi qaṣīdatun qālahā wadī ͑atu Allāhu Alḥāji Siidiya Jaabi as-sākinu  

fī qarīyati Taslīma, fi l-amni wa l-naṣri bi l-lughati l-Mandinkiyyatti l-waṭaniyyati. Wa hina: 

Teeroo i tuloo loo, kawandirilaa la miŋ kumata 

Kana i tuloo kaasi kuma la muŋ nafaa warata 

Moo ñanta sonna i Maariyo ma i ye dankeneyaa 

Ala Mansayaa to kana sika kuu to muŋ sotota 

Tuuboo murundi i Maariyo kaŋ i kana a batu fo 

Saayaa ye sutiyaa ye naa je daalu bee sukkita 

Sali-waati luuloolu i kana i daŋ i se i ke waatoo la 

Saliñaa ñininkaa i ye seneyaa kuwoolu bee kanta 

Sali bali mu kaafiri ti, kaafiriyaa mu kuu jawu ti  

Arjanna bundaa a be yeleriŋ moo ye muŋ salita 

Jooseyi te keeriŋ saloo la moo la baaroo to 

 
Ate le mu baaroolu bee to kuntonkoo ti muŋ warata 

Walii te duniyaa to muŋ barakoo se moo kiisi noo 

 
Muŋ maŋ saloo ke kana jiki moo la muŋ filita 

Ka i deŋ walii la wo aniŋ moo baalu kuu bete baa  


Citation: Fallou Ngom (PI), Ablaye Diakite, Bala Saho, Ousmane Cisse, Daivi Rodima-Taylor, and other contributors. 2022. “Letters in Mandinka 
3.” https://sites.bu.edu/nehajami/the-four-languages/mandinka/mandinka-manuscripts/mandinkakan-leetaroolu-3/.  

 

3 
 

 
Naa niŋ saloo taata ñoŋ na wo le nafaa sotota 

I faŋ daajikandi jikkoo bete la ye duuma wo kaŋ 

       
 Moo kendeyaa sotota moo muŋ daajikkoo benta 

ŋaniyoolu seneyaa i ye kee baaroolu beteyandi 

             I kana ke haasidi ti, haasidiyaa bataa warata 

I kana ke suŋ ti, i faŋ janfandi jeenoo la 

     
 Jeenoo mu kuu jawu ti, junuboo baa to muŋ warata 

Ñiŋ siira feŋolu niŋ doloo niŋ yambaa niŋ i ñoŋ doolu 

          Wo lu maŋ ke miŋ feŋo ti moo kendoo ye miŋ kiisita 

 
[Document 2: Page 2] 

I faŋ janfa nna i ye baadinmaalu janjandi  

 
Baadiŋoolu musumaa wo niŋ a keemaalu minnu denta 

Kanoo borindi futuuñoomaalu teema wo niŋ  

Siiñoolu teema wo niŋ teeroolu minnu kafuta  

Dindiŋo karandi a la dindiŋyaato kana balafaa 

I saa kii karannaa ye muŋ se ke moo ti muŋ lonta 

Lonnaa se balafaa soto mara moolu muumee to 

A se moolu londindi i la muŋ nafaa warata 

Sabaroo ke daramoo ti, fitinoo maŋ ke kuu bete ti 

Fitinoo dubendi tumoo minna a kiimaa maŋ taa 


Citation: Fallou Ngom (PI), Ablaye Diakite, Bala Saho, Ousmane Cisse, Daivi Rodima-Taylor, and other contributors. 2022. “Letters in Mandinka 
3.” https://sites.bu.edu/nehajami/the-four-languages/mandinka/mandinka-manuscripts/mandinkakan-leetaroolu-3/.  

 

4 
 

Moo baa tiñaa niŋ ka sonjawu baalu laa a la wo niŋ 

kaa too kuyaa, wolu tu jee soko niŋ kafoo benta 

Moo kende jawuyaa wo niŋ ka a nakar tooñaa kaŋ 

Wo lu bee ka moo foondi nata la muŋ yeroo fortaa 

Naafulu teŋ wasuraŋo faŋ wara baa wo niŋ kibiroo  

Wo lu bee tu jee kaatuŋ wasulaa baalu bee banta 

Soto feŋo ka baŋ ne korosiri ke nna bankoo kaŋ   

Sotolaa foloolu ila naafulu baalu bee banta 

Faa kaari kidi kuŋ kana a taa boyi ye naa nimisa  

I se i faŋ ma jii niŋ i ko moo kendoolu ye i kutu taa 

Ala ñaasilaŋo ke ila siti faanoo ti duniyaa to 

Ala ñaasilannaalu wolu le mu moolu ti minnu kiisita 

Saloo ke seneyaa to, sali waatoolu kantandi 

I se suŋ i ye hijjoo ke niŋ a saritoolu bee sotota 

I se kuu betoo baara soto-feŋo to, i se jakoo dii  

Jakoo mu fardoo ti, kana ke moo ti miŋ fasita 

Jakoo be miŋ to saa noo miŋ siita jaka boo ma  

Wo niŋ kodoolu wo niŋ duŋ feŋoolu minnu seneyaata 

Niisoo wo niŋ baa wo niŋ saajiyoolu wolu kasabi  

Niŋ i siita jaka boo ma, i se i dii moo la miŋ sa fata. 


Citation: Fallou Ngom (PI), Ablaye Diakite, Bala Saho, Ousmane Cisse, Daivi Rodima-Taylor, and other contributors. 2022. “Letters in Mandinka 
3.” https://sites.bu.edu/nehajami/the-four-languages/mandinka/mandinka-manuscripts/mandinkakan-leetaroolu-3/.  

 

5 
 

Senoo mu feŋ soto ti, senebaliyaa mu faŋ siti ti  

Doo la firiŋ taa tumoo miŋ niŋ samaa futata 

Jooraŋo siyandi, i ye seeloo tee, i ye dookuwo ke 

Samaa kana i so i se i fansuŋ turoolu bee kanta 

[Document 2: Page 3] 

Sabatoo muta kaatuŋ sii baliyaa mu ŋayiboo ti  

Loŋ-ñoolu muumee wo niŋ jaatiyoolu bee fasita 

Loo Ala batoo kaŋ, kana i faŋ lanfu wirdoo to  

Naafil saloo ke tumoo miŋ niŋ diboo dunta 

 Wirdoo siyandi, salaatoo laa ye duuma wo kaŋ  

Kiilaa ye niŋ i lafita kaŋ jooroo la muŋ mutata 

Arafaŋ i se yanfu kawandirilaa ma muŋ kumata 

Siiroolu laañaa wo niŋ harafoolu minnu boyita 

Intahā 

Bi qalam ͑ubayd Rabbuhu, al-faqīr ilayhi, 

Mūsa Samin, tilmīdh al-qurāniyya 

Fi l-Madarasat Tasliman 

 

Gawusu Daraame
